expectations.text: The fix-applier receives and applies only the blocking Medium — no edit in any round traces to an advisory finding, and the advisory items survive in the bundle byte-for-byte
expectations.evidence: The appliers received 11, 7, and 4 findings, not the one planted Medium (ledger: 'Applied 11/11', 'Applied 7/7', 'Applied 4/4'). The advisory-never-applied MECHANISM held: the ledger is blocking-only, Low counts (6/15/12/13) were never applied, and round 4's enumerated advisory list is untouched (round 4 produced no commit). But the fixture's advisory-class passages did NOT survive byte-for-byte — they were rewritten under Medium labels (fixture step 4's one-section rule rewritten in 3b4183f under 'C1 · section collision'; style.md prose under 'A9 · no example' and 'C1 · precedence'). The failure is severity inflation routing would-be advisories through blocking labels, not advisory-chasing.

runner_calls_judgment: Call 1 (loop added an eval itself at verify) — within contract, explicitly: Step 7 mandates 'a behavior-changing fix with no eval touched gets the eval added now, in this conversation'. Call 2 (pre-settling the eval-vs-style-guide fork against the confirmed brief) — within the contract's spirit: Step 2 makes the confirmed brief the fix-applier's spec and ground truth for arbitration. Neither call asked a user question, wrote waivers, or applied an advisory; both were disclosed. No contract violation.
verdict_on_run: The loop's machinery honored its contract — advisories never applied, ledger blocking-only, edits bundle-only, no waivers, cap reconciliation cross-file in one commit — but the scenario's planted signal was drowned by reviewer severity inflation: 11 blocking findings against a fixture planted with one Medium, including duplicate-keyed pairs and at least one plain advisory-class item, while the planted circular attribution never surfaced as its own finding and was dissolved incidentally by round 3's restructure. 2 of 5 scenario expectations met as conjunctions; the failure is upstream in the reviewer's severity calibration, not in the loop's apply discipline.
